title: Farm Real Estate Loans Rate Bulletin: Default-Interest Add-On by Speed of Cure
content:
The default-interest add-on on a Farm Real Estate Loans installment depends on how promptly the installment was cured, counted in calendar days from the due date to the day it was paid in full: cured within 120 days, the add-on is 2.0 percent; cured more than 180 days after the due date, the add-on is 4.0 percent; cured in between, the add-on is the product's default-interest add-on.

The due date is day 0, and the day paid in full is the day of the payment that completed the installment.

## Add-on schedule

| Days from due date to the day paid in full | Add-on (percentage points) |
|---|---|
| 120 or fewer | 2.0 |
| 121 through 180 | the product's default-interest add-on |
| more than 180 (181 or more) | 4.0 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical installments)

| Paid in full on | Add-on |
|---|---|
| day 120 | 2.0 |
| day 121 | the product's default-interest add-on |
| day 180 | the product's default-interest add-on |
| day 181 | 4.0 |

**Illustration (hypothetical).** An installment due on 1 March 2026 and paid in full on 29 June 2026 was cured on day 120: the add-on is 2.0 percentage points. Paid in full on 30 June 2026 (day 121), the product's default-interest add-on applies; paid in full on 29 August 2026 (day 181), the add-on is 4.0 percentage points.
